description: This PHP source file defines the 'Zone' class within the Opencart admin localisation module. It contains methods for managing zone records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, fetching, and retrieving zone descriptions. The class interacts with the database, cache, and other models to handle zone-related data.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: A model class for managing localisation zones within the OpenCart admin interface, including CRUD operations and description management.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Creates a new zone record in the database, inserting zone data and descriptions, and clears the related cache.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Updates an existing zone record with new data, replaces descriptions, and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Deletes a zone record and its descriptions from the database, and clears cache.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves a zone record along with its description in the current language.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches a list of zones with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves zones associated with a specific country ID, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of zone records based on optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts zones associated with a particular country.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Creates a description record for a zone in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records associated with a specific zone.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all zone descriptions for a particular language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific zone description for a given zone and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for a specific zone across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all zone descriptions in a specific language.
